HIGH: Price inconsistency - /web-development-cyprus headlines '$900 USD' while its own linked blog post quotes '€800-€3,500'

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt live-verified correct: explicit Allow: / for GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended; only /admin disallowed
Prerendering verified live for all real routes - non-JS raw fetch returns full content, is_spa:false
Full modern security header set (HSTS preload, real CSP, X-Frame-Options, Permissions-Policy)
Unique titles/descriptions/self-referencing canonicals on every real route
IndexNow wired into build/deploy

findings.title: Wildcard route rewrites create a soft-404 duplicate-content trap
findings.description:
vercel.json rewrites /blogs/:slug and /projects/:id unconditionally to /spa.html for ANY slug/id. Verified live: nonexistent slugs return HTTP 200 with the homepage's title/description, 'index, follow', no canonical, and a blank
body - exactly what non-JS AI crawlers receive.
findings.recommendation: Add "handle": "filesystem" before these rewrites in vercel.json so real prerendered pages are served first; make the true fallback return HTTP 404 (or noindex) instead of indexable 200.

findings.title: Double redirect hop from bare HTTP apex
findings.description: http://webdevstudio.me/ takes two 308 hops (apex-http -> apex-https -> www-https) instead of one.
findings.recommendation: Configure the apex domain alias at Vercel/DNS to redirect straight to https://www.webdevstudio.me/.

findings.title: Dead Google Fonts preconnect for a JS-gated font
findings.description: Plus Jakarta Sans only loads via a JS-promoted <link rel=preload as=style>; non-JS renders (including the broken spa.html fallback) never see it, making the preconnect hints dead weight for those requests.
findings.recommendation: No CWV action required. If brand typography in no-JS snapshots matters, self-host a woff2 subset referenced directly in the prerendered head.

findings.title: Offer/PriceSpecification schema ships placeholder prices
findings.description: Structured pricing data ($900/$2,500/$1,200-mo) is technically valid but still owner-unconfirmed, per project memory.
findings.recommendation: No technical fix needed - flagged for the content/business workstream before pursuing further rich-result eligibility.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Blog thinness fully resolved: 13 posts, 850-2,150 words each, real structural depth
Location pages resolved: 650-750 unique words each with FAQs, cities served, market pricing
Strong trust engineering on About/Contact (transparent CV note, honeypot spam protection, real contact info)
Technical accuracy is high throughout (correct CWV thresholds, named tools, real code samples)

findings.title: Case-study proof gap - all 6 projects unverifiable
findings.description: repoUrl, demoUrl, context, completedAt, roleDetail, and screenshots are null/empty for all 6 projects; outcome is null for 5 of 6. The codebase's own hasVerifiableProof() returns false for every case study.
findings.recommendation: Populate at minimum one of {repoUrl, demoUrl, screenshot} plus a numeric outcome per project - this is the single highest-severity credibility risk on the site.

findings.title: Testimonials still empty
findings.description: TESTIMONIALS = [] in src/data/testimonials.ts, zero verified:true entries; section self-hides.
findings.recommendation: Collect 2-3 real, verified testimonials - the verified:true mechanism is already built, this is a data-entry gap only.

findings.title: Case-study cover images are generic stock photos, not real work
findings.description: 19 Unsplash stock-photo usages stand in for actual product screenshots across blog and case-study covers.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real application screenshots once available; same category of credibility risk the codebase's own testimonial-fabrication guard already warns against.

findings.title: Case studies missing completedAt / dateCreated
findings.description: No freshness signal exists for crawlers evaluating portfolio recency - CreativeWork.dateCreated is omitted for all 6 projects.
findings.recommendation: Add completedAt per project.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Cost/comparison blog cluster is the strongest on-page cluster on the site (SXO gap score 74/100) - page type matches SERP consensus almost exactly
/services correctly delegates cost-intent to dedicated blog posts rather than competing directly
Titles, meta descriptions, and heading hierarchy are clean and unique sitewide

findings.title: Geo landing pages and /services fail 'Required Elements' for their page type
findings.description: Service Page format is correct, but zero images and zero testimonials on /web-development-new-zealand, /web-development-cyprus, and /services fail the case-study/trust-signal requirement Google's top results for these queries all satisfy.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one identifiable client name/logo, a team/founder photo, and populate linked case studies (see Content Quality).

findings.title: Price inconsistency between Cyprus landing page and its own linked blog post
findings.description: /web-development-cyprus headlines "$900 USD" while /blogs/website-cost-cyprus-2026 quotes "€800-€3,500" - two different currencies and framings for one price story.
findings.recommendation: Align currency and framing between the geo landing page and its linked cost guide before a price-sensitive buyer notices mid-funnel.

findings.title: custom-web-app-cost-2026 missing a comparison table its sibling posts have
findings.description: Structures its core answer as 'three price bands' but has zero <table> elements, unlike the NZ/Cyprus cost posts.
findings.recommendation: Add a pricing table matching the sibling posts' format for scannability/snippet eligibility.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: One connected @graph per route via routeGraph(), verified identical between repo source and deployed site, no drift
No deprecated types anywhere (no HowTo, no SpecialAnnouncement)
Organization/Person/WebSite/WebPage/BreadcrumbList/BlogPosting/CreativeWork all pass required and recommended property checks
Schema prices are internally consistent across every page and FAQ copy
Privacy-conscious, intentional omissions (no telephone, country-only PostalAddress, no fabricated Review/AggregateRating) are correct, not gaps

findings.title: Breadcrumb label on geo pages is the full marketing title, not a short crumb name
findings.description: breadcrumbNode() derives crumb name from route.title.split('|')[0] - for the two geo pages (no '|' in title) the entire SEO title becomes the breadcrumb label.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit short crumbLabel field per route (e.g. 'New Zealand', 'Cyprus') and use it in breadcrumbNode() with a fallback to title-split for routes that don't set one.

findings.title: WebPage node never references its own BreadcrumbList
findings.description: Every non-home route emits a BreadcrumbList but webPageNode() never sets WebPage.breadcrumb to point at it - a missed @id edge in an otherwise carefully cross-referenced graph.
findings.recommendation: Give BreadcrumbList a stable @id (${url}#breadcrumb) and add breadcrumb: {"@id": ...} to the matching WebPage node.

findings.title: /blogs listing page dateModified understates its own freshness
findings.description: WebPage.dateModified for /blogs is hand-maintained at 2026-07-30 while its own blogPost array lists posts dated as recently as 2026-08-09.
findings.recommendation: Derive /blogs' lastmod automatically from Math.max() of BLOG_POSTS dates rather than hand-maintaining it.

findings.title: Article/case-study images below Google's recommended width
findings.description: BlogPosting.image and CreativeWork.image are 800px wide; Google recommends >=1200px for large-image treatment.
findings.recommendation: Bump the Unsplash w= param to 1200 next time these are touched.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: DOM size healthy on every page (271-943 elements)
CLS excellent on 3 of 4 pages (0.00003-0.0006) thanks to explicit image dimensions and SSR-prerendering
No render-blocking resources on any page
/services (no images) achieves the best LCP of the four pages tested, proving the animation pattern - not image weight - is the dominant lever

findings.title: Scroll-reveal animation gates above-the-fold LCP elements
findings.description: useIntersectionObserver (used in 18 components) starts elements at opacity-0 until a post-hydration observer callback fires. On home/services/projects this adds 1.7-3.5s of pure 'element render delay' to LCP even though content is already in the prerendered DOM.
findings.recommendation: Exempt above-the-fold content from the reveal pattern - render it visible immediately or default isVisible=true for the first viewport section.

findings.title: Blog post LCP dominated by a 5.4s third-party image load
findings.description: images.unsplash.com hero image takes 5.4s to load (no preconnect), driving a 6.42s total LCP despite the file being only 24KB.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel=preconnect> to images.unsplash.com; consider self-hosting/proxying hero images through Vercel's image optimization.

findings.title: /services fails CLS (0.241) from a font-load-triggered layout shift
findings.description: A decorative background blob shifts when Plus Jakarta Sans swaps in, producing a large-area shift.
findings.recommendation: Preload the primary font weight used above the fold and/or use a size-adjusted fallback so text doesn't reflow on font arrival.

findings.title: Elevated TTFB on home (999ms) and blog (1,603ms)
findings.description: Well above the <800ms CrUX-good target; services/projects TTFB (287-679ms) is fine, suggesting a route-specific serving issue.
findings.recommendation: Confirm these routes are served from static/prerendered output, not a serverless function per request; consider edge caching.

findings.title: Heavy/unused JS inflates TBT (INP risk)
findings.description: GTM ships 166-169KB with ~55% unused; app bundle has 37-43% unused bytes on every page load.
findings.recommendation: Defer GTM loading; route-split the shared bundle; replace transition-all with explicit property lists.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: AI crawler access verified live and correctly scoped for all 7 named agents
Prerendering verified working for AI/non-JS crawlers (not just claimed)
Strong on-page entity graph (Person/Organization with sameAs to verified-live GitHub/LinkedIn)
llms.txt present, well-structured, in sync with sitemap (informational value only - ignored by Google Search)
Direct-answer FAQ framing and real pricing tables aid extraction

findings.title: Answer passages well below the AI-citation sweet spot
findings.description: FAQ answers run 28-52 words and blog H2 sections run 30-96 words, versus the 134-167 word benchmark for optimal AI-citation passage length.
findings.recommendation: Add one concrete sentence of specificity (a caveat, a worked example, a number) to each answer - pure content edit.

findings.title: Zero outbound citations in sampled blog posts
findings.description: No external links to any source/standard/reference exist in article bodies - weakens the site for Perplexity specifically, which favors sourced content.
findings.recommendation: Link claims to primary sources (MDN, web.dev, framework docs) where relevant.

findings.title: No owned video/community presence
findings.description: Zero YouTube, Reddit, or Wikipedia signals - YouTube has the strongest AI-citation correlation in the reference dataset (~0.737) vs backlinks (~0.266).
findings.recommendation: Even 1-2 short YouTube videos linked from case studies, plus genuine r/webdev or r/reactjs participation, would materially change the current entity-signal profile.

findings.title: No RSL 1.0 licensing file
findings.description: /rsl.xml and /license.xml both 404.
findings.recommendation: Low priority given emerging adoption, but cheap to auto-generate alongside llms.txt.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Image alt-text coverage is 100% on sampled pages
Homepage, /projects, and blog posts now load real (if generic) hero/thumbnail images, up from zero
Explicit width/height on every image prevents CLS

findings.title: Zero real project screenshots - stock photos stand in and risk misrepresentation
findings.description: Every case-study/project image is generic Unsplash stock (hands on paperwork, a hospital lobby, a generic dashboard mockup) - none depict the actual delivered UI. A visitor evaluating technical credibility sees zero evidence of the product itself, and stock photos on branded 'case studies' risk reading as misrepresentation.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real screenshots (even low-fi/annotated ones) or fall back to the existing icon-based treatment used on /services rather than stock photography.

findings.title: Homepage and /about have zero images, including no founder headshot
findings.description: The About page - the highest-trust placement for a photo - has no headshot of Muhammad Mubashar Shahzad.
findings.recommendation: Add a founder headshot to /about.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix vercel.json soft-404: add "handle": "filesystem" before the /blogs/:slug and /projects/:id rewrites; make the true fallback return 404/noindex instead of an indexable 200
Verify the /services and project-detail blank footer/CTA band live in a scrolled browser session - confirm it's a capture artifact, not a real content/contrast bug
Align Cyprus pricing currency/framing between /web-development-cyprus and /blogs/website-cost-cyprus-2026

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Exempt above-the-fold content from the scroll-reveal (IntersectionObserver) animation pattern - highest-leverage performance fix, worth 1.5-3.5s LCP on 3 of 4 pages
Add preconnect to images.unsplash.com and preload the primary webfont weight used above the fold (fixes both LCP and the /services CLS failure)
Fix the internal link matrix across the 13 blog posts - pure editing effort, brings all posts to 3+ inbound sibling links and zero orphans
Populate at least one verifiable proof field (repoUrl, demoUrl, or screenshot) plus a numeric outcome per case study - root cause of the site-wide Trust deficit found in the SXO persona scoring
Add short crumbLabel fields for the two geo-page breadcrumbs

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Collect 2-3 real, verified testimonials (mechanism already built)
Replace stock case-study/blog cover images with real product screenshots as they become available
Add a founder headshot to /about
Expand the four content-cluster pillars toward true pillar depth (2,500-4,000 words), prioritizing mern-stack-architecture-guide (~850 words, worst gap) and why-is-my-website-slow (~1,200 words)
Lengthen thin FAQ/answer passages toward 134-167 words and add outbound citations to blog posts
Create free/verified profiles on Clutch and DesignRush once case-study proof exists
Add at least one client name/logo and a team photo to both geo landing pages

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run Lighthouse after the animation-pattern fix to confirm LCP improvement across home/services/projects
Re-check Common Crawl / re-run backlinks audit once the site accumulates its first referring domains (next quarterly crawl cycle)
Confirm each new case-study edit bumps only that project's own updatedAt rather than leaving the 2026-08-09 batch date frozen
Watch geo-page count against the 30-page quality-gate threshold if more country pages are added
Investigate elevated TTFB on home/blog routes (confirm static serving, not serverless cold starts)
